359:t_2:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Colonel...! Please go to the $$プトレマイオス$$ briefing room at once.」

359:t_2:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We've received a transmission from $$クロノ$$'s $$クィーン$$.」

359:t_2:33.en: ～$$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room～

359:t_2:34.en:
$$クィーン$$
「...Have you gathered the people I requested?」

359:t_2:35.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You mean $$桂木桂$$, $$シャア・アズナブル$$, and the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s, correct?」

359:t_2:36.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We chose the other attendees ourselves.」

359:t_2:38.en:
$$桂$$
(So that's the $$クィーン$$ everyone's talking about.)

359:t_2:39.en:
$$ランド$$
(She's got a pretty bland face.)

359:t_2:40.en:
$n
(That's an avatar... Basically, a stand-in face to conceal her identity.)

359:t_2:41.en:
$$ランド$$
(Look, $n... even a guy raised in the wilderness knows that much.)

359:t_2:42.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$ＵＣＷ$$ had a well-developed 《$$ＵＮ$$》, so we're used to this sort of anonymity.)

359:t_2:43.en:
$$ランド$$
(I've got no great memories of that, though...)

359:t_2:44.en:
$$クロウ$$
(The question is why $$クィーン$$ specifically wanted to speak to us...)

359:t_2:45.en:
$$シャア$$
($$桂$$ and I are $$特異点$$s... You draw out $$次元力$$...)

359:t_2:46.en:
$$シャア$$
(As I suspected, $$クロノ$$ must have something to do with this multiverse.)

359:t_2:47.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$クィーン$$... why did you contact us?」

359:t_2:48.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I wanted to see your faces and speak with you... That was my main reason.」

359:t_2:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「May we ask who you are, what you want... and the rest?」

359:t_2:50.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It's hard to take that from a masked man...」

359:t_2:53.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I've seen your resolve, $$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$.」

359:t_2:54.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I'd appreciate it if you didn't call me that.」

359:t_2:55.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Do you want to deny your time as emperor? Or is it your relationship with your father?」

359:t_2:56.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I see... So you have information about us, too.」

359:t_2:57.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「You certainly live up to your claim of belonging to $$クロノ$$, an organization that spans parallel worlds.」

359:t_2:58.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I see $$破嵐万丈$$ told you about that.」

359:t_2:59.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We've made contact with members of $$クロノ$$ several times.」

359:t_2:60.en:
$$クィーン$$
「You mean the so-called Reformists.」

359:t_2:61.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「From the way you speak, you aren't a Reformist... Does that mean you're a Conservative?」

359:t_2:63.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Conservatives monitor humanity's evolution, and the Reformists watch over it... I belong to neither.」

359:t_2:64.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Are you claiming to be a third $$クロノ$$ faction?」

359:t_2:65.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Let's see... Perhaps I should call myself someone who couldn't care less about humanity's evolution.」

359:t_2:66.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You have quite a lot of freedom.」

359:t_2:67.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Judging by your nickname, '$$クィーン$$,' I assumed you held a very high position...」

359:t_2:68.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Each successive head of $$クロノ$$ is given the name '$$キング$$'... I was his secretary, so I was named $$クィーン$$.」

359:t_2:69.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Your talk of successive $$クロノ$$ leaders suggests that you at least used to belong to the Conservatives.」

359:t_2:70.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I'll leave that to your imagination.」

359:t_2:71.en:
$$クィーン$$
「But I have at least provided you with useful information.」

359:t_2:72.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's true. We recovered this $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$ thanks to your information.」

359:t_2:73.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Why exactly are you helping us?」

359:t_2:74.en:
$$クィーン$$
「As I said, I have no interest in evolution, the very foundation of $$クロノ$$'s doctrine.」

359:t_2:75.en:
$$クィーン$$
「In fact, I'd prefer the Conservatives and Reformists to destroy each other.」

359:t_2:77.en:
$$クィーン$$
「They want the present to continue. But I want the past... the peace that's been lost.」

359:t_2:79.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I hate the very existence of the multiverse.」

359:t_2:80.en:
$$桂$$
「I see. So that's why you called me here.」

359:t_2:81.en:
$$クィーン$$
「$$桂木桂$$... I can't forgive your existence... the original $$特異点$$ who created the multiverse.」

359:t_2:82.en:
$$クィーン$$
「But I can't bear to see $$サイデリアル$$ exploit it, either.」

359:t_2:84.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I have new information for you...」

359:t_2:85.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The whereabouts of $$オルソン・Ｄ・ヴェルヌ$$.」

359:t_10:3.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Goodbye, $$マリーダ$$. Take care of yourself.」

359:t_10:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「If anything happens, come straight back.」

359:t_10:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I know. My home is wherever you are, Master.」

359:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My name is $$ＡＧ$$. I serve as $$マリーダ$$'s manager in $c...」

359:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm thinking of launching her with $$クェス$$ and $$フォウ$$ as the $$パワードシスターズ$$.」

359:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's what we call a dimension joke.」

359:t_10:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Master... you can ignore this thing.」

359:t_10:14.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「And let me warn you, $$ＡＧ$$. I won't tolerate any disrespect toward Master.」

359:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. I know how deeply $$マリーダ$$ cares about $$ジンネマン$$.」

359:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When $$ジンネマン$$ distinguished himself in our last battle, $$マリーダ$$ produced 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

359:t_10:17.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You really do work hard whenever $$Ｚチップ$$s are involved.」

359:t_10:21.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Nothing... hearing you talk with this thing made me realize you've settled into $c.」

359:t_10:22.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...I feel at home here.」

359:t_10:23.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Do your best, $$マリーダ$$. And whatever you do, don't die.」
